offer.text: A pillager band's been shaking down travelers on the trade road. The crossbow crowd, the standard-bearers, all of them — clear out six and there's good coin waiting.

accept.text: Watch for their crossbows. They shoot before they parley.

decline.text: More for the next blade, then.

in_progress.text: How many of the band have you put down?

ready.text: Six raiders cold on the road. The merchants will breathe easier.

complete.text: The road's safer for honest folk now. Take your bounty — you earned it.
